thread:
alex: Postmortem drafted and uploaded: https://redwood.docs/postmortem/1768521947 — root cause is KV cache thrashing under a traffic spike. We blew part of the error budget for p95/p99. Need follow-ups: SLO decisions, owners, dashboards.

maria: Reading now. TL;DR — recurring pattern: cache eviction + bursty long tails. I think we need both infra fix and better SLO observability.

sam: Agreed. My immediate thought: do NOT loosen SLOs yet. Instead add short-term capacity and a targeted autoscale rule during promos. Who owns that?

jin: I can own infra remediation (cache tuning + config). ETA: 2 weeks for safe rollout. Will open RFC + PR today.

product_ops: We should also decide if the customer-facing SLA wording needs a correction. We missed p99 300ms for 4 hours during incident window. I can draft comms once we decide SLO/SLA posture.

alex: Action plan proposal (quick): 1) infra fix owner = jin (2w) 2) autoscale/ops policy = sam (3 days) 3) SLO observability/dashboard = maria (2 days) 4) customer comms draft = product_ops (after SLO decision) 5) follow-up owner = alex to track. Please ack and add due dates. :white_check_mark:

maria: Ack. I'll add a Grafana panel + synthetic probe. PromQL for the new panel (5m rolling):
```
(sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference",le="0.3"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="inference"}[5m]))) * 100
```
I'll push panel JSON to the infra-dash repo.

sam: Ack. I'll implement an autoscale policy that triggers additional capacity when p95 latency > 250ms for 3m during high traffic. I'll also add a temporary quota bypass for dedicated pools during the next promo window. ETA 72h.

jin: Starting RFC: cache size increase + smarter eviction (LRU tweak + prefetch). I'll include a canary plan and rollback steps. ETA RFC + dev PR by EOD tomorrow.

tyler: Can we add an always-on error-budget burn alert so we get paged before SLA is at risk? Example: alert when 24h burn rate > 50% and remaining budget < 25%. Whoever owns alerting — please add it.

maria: I'll add the alert and a dashboard tile that shows rolling error budget, burn rate, and top 5 call paths contributing to latency. Linking draft dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/dash/errbudgets/17685-draft

oncall-bot: Incident 1768521947 marked RESOLVED by alex. Silence window until follow-ups complete.

alex: Good. I'll create a tracking task in #postmortem-action-items with owners and dates: jin (2026-04-07), sam (2026-03-31), maria (2026-03-31), product_ops (wait on SLO decision). I'll run weekly check-ins until all closed.

product_ops: For the SLA copy — let's hold until infra fixes land. If we expect >2 weeks to stabilize p99, we might need a temporary, precisely-worded exception. Will draft language and tag legal if needed.

sam: One more note: recurring incident pattern — similar spike seen in Jan and Feb. I recommend we add a monthly trend report of cache misses vs. request shape to identify windows. I'll add to my TODO.

maria: Added the synthetic test (5m) and dashboard tile. Will post panel PR link here once merged.

alex: Thanks all. Summary: don't change customer SLA yet, ramp short-term capacity, infra fix in 2w, add SLO/dash observability and alerting, track via #postmortem-action-items. Next sync Friday. :calendar:
